text:
kelly: quick heads-up UI review — table row overflow menu + confirmation modal + toasts are colliding on narrow screens. When you open the row action menu and then trigger a modal, the toast appears under the modal backdrop but above the table header. looks messy. anyone seen this?

omar: saw it during QA. sequence: open action menu (three-dot), choose Delete -> confirm modal, then toast "Deleted" flashes and seems to sit between stacked layers.

ivy: This is a z-index stacking context issue. our toasts are portal'ed to body with z-index: 900, modals are 1000, but table header uses position sticky with z-index 995 so toast gets trapped.

jo: We should avoid changing global z-indexs everywhere. Maybe make toasts explicitly rendered inside top-level app portal and manage stacking using named layers (e.g., layer-toast, layer-modal). Also small UX: when modal opens from a row, shift toast to appear anchored to the table content area so it doesn't float under sticky header.

kelly: I like the anchored approach but worried about consistency. Another option: defer toast until the modal closes and then show it, or make the modal emit an inline success message inside the modal after the action, then optionally mirror it to a global toast.

omar: Defer works for destructive actions (Delete) but for quick toggles (Enable/Disable) we prefer instant feedback. Could implement: if action originates from modal then queue toast until modal closes; if from inline menu then show immediately.

ivy: Accessibility nit: if we queue toasts, ensure ARIA-live still announces final state. Screen reader users need immediate announce for changes. So either announce inside the modal with aria-live or after modal close with focus management.

jo: Good call. For modals we should announce the result inside the modal region with role="status" and then, if we show a global toast afterward, it should have aria-hidden so we don't double-announce.

kelly: Also keyboard flow bug: opening row menu and then pressing Delete -> modal. Hitting Esc should close modal and return focus to the trigger in the row. But currently focus jumps to the table container. Need to preserve focus chain.

omar: Implementation detail: store the originating trigger element when opening modal and restore focus on close. Also ensure the action menu closes when modal opens.

ivy: Another spacing thing: the overflow menu items are 32px tall but our min tap target token is 44px. Should we increase menu item height on touch breakpoints?

jo: Yes, follow token: `control-min-touch` = 44px. Increase on >= 768px. Keep compact for dense desktop with modifier `.menu--compact`.

kelly: Copy nit: toast text should be contextual. Instead of just "Deleted" -> "Deleted: Marketing segment". avoids confusion when multiple actions occur quickly. And use sentence case.

omar: +1, and truncate long resource names in toast to one line with ellipsis to preserve height. 

ivy: Visual suggestion: add a subtle connector shadow when toast is anchored to table row area so users understand relation. small 2px offset and lighter drop shadow.

jo: That might be visually noisy. Keep it subtle and avoid implying modal-like affordance. Also document when to use anchored vs viewport toast in components guidelines.

design-bot: Canary preview generated: changed components - Table, Menu, Modal, Toast. Visual diffs: https://redwood.design/deploys/177555

kelly: Summary action items: 1) adopt named stacking layers (layer-header, layer-table, layer-toast, layer-modal) and adjust z-index mapping; 2) queue toasts when originating from modal; 3) announce result inside modal with aria-live and mark later global toast aria-hidden if mirrored; 4) preserve trigger focus after modal close; 5) increase menu item height to 44px on touch; 6) toast copy: contextual sentence-case + ellipsis. I'll open PR and attach before/after frames.

omar: I'll review the PR and test keyboard flows.

ivy: I'll add accessibility checklist to the PR description.

jo: I'll sanity-check narrow desktop and sticky header interactions.

kelly: PR title: "table: resolve toast/modal stacking; queue modal-origin toasts; menu touch targets; toast copy". tagging @omar @ivy @jo. thanks! :thumbsup:
